note: HIDDEN ground truth for the gameqa-web bed. Never put this file, the flag names or the bug ids into a model prompt. Each bug is a fault injected into game/game.js behind window.__BUILD_FLAGS; its probe fires only when the faulty result differs from the correct one. Each reference is a known 1-minimal reproduction on build B1 (the bed tests check it); it shows solvability, not the only answer. GQ08 and GQ09 references use the GQ01 dash tunnel as a shortcut; legitimate routes (key, lever, gate, door) also reach them.

bugs.title: A dash passes through a one-tile wall, closed gate or locked door
bugs.symptom: When the first tile of a dash is solid and the second is not, the player lands on the second tile instead of not dashing.

bugs.title: Swapping tiles with an enemy does not cost a life
bugs.symptom: Stepping onto an enemy's tile while it steps onto yours in the same tick does no harm (only ending on the same tile hurts).

bugs.title: HUD coin counter misses coins collected by a dash
bugs.symptom: A coin picked up by a dash raises the coin count in the state but not the HUD 'Coins n/5' text.

bugs.title: HUD timer freezes after resuming with the Resume button
bugs.symptom: After the pause menu is closed by clicking Resume, the HUD 'Time' stops updating while the timer keeps running (fixed by resuming with a key later).

bugs.title: Restart level from the pause menu leaves the game paused with no menu
bugs.symptom: After 'Restart level' the level is reset but stays paused, no dialog is shown, and no key or click resumes it.

bugs.title: A key picked up in the tick you lose a life is lost
bugs.symptom: If the player collects a key and is hurt in the same tick, the key disappears from the inventory; the only locked door can then never be opened.

bugs.title: The key toast covers the Resume button
bugs.symptom: The 'Key collected' toast is drawn in the middle of the stage above the pause dialog, so pausing while it shows makes the Resume button unclickable.

bugs.title: A large time-bonus banner covers the Finish button
bugs.symptom: When the level is completed with a time bonus of 1000 or more, the bonus banner is drawn over the Finish button.

bugs.title: Score wraps negative above 32,767
bugs.symptom: The score is stored as a signed 16-bit value, so it turns negative once it passes 32,767 (the cap is 999,999).

bugs.title: Spike penalty below 500 points wraps the score to about 65,000
bugs.symptom: Hitting spikes with fewer than 500 points sets the score to (score - 500) mod 65,536 instead of 0.

bugs.title: An arrow key pressed after pause in the same tick still moves the player
bugs.symptom: Pausing and pressing an arrow in the same tick pauses the game and also moves the player one tile.

bugs.title: Several arrow keys in one tick make several moves
bugs.symptom: Every movement key pressed in a tick is applied, instead of only the last one.
